name: Raphael
role: TFAH literary character (Milton's Paradise Lost) -- archangel sent by God to warn Adam directly of Satan's approach.
description: TFAH literary character. Category B: appears ONLY in the deuterocanonical Book of Tobit, excluded from the Protestant canon. Milton's choice of him as the most fully developed, dialogue-rich angelic personality is a genuine sourcing irony. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §V.
narrative_function: Warns Adam of Satan; recounts the War in Heaven and Creation; shares a meal with Adam and Eve.
